name: viora-bills
description: Professional web-based invoice and business billing application

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,ADMIN:5173,CUSTOMER:5174,SUPERADMIN:5175" -c "blue.bold,teal.bold,cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev:admin --workspace=client" "npm run dev:customer --workspace=client" "npm run dev:superadmin --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace=server && npm run type-check --workspace=client
scripts.test:release: npx tsx server/test-p0.ts && npx tsx server/test-p1.ts && npx tsx server/test-endpoints.ts && npx tsx server/test-stabilization.ts && npm run test:review && npx tsx server/test-roadmap.ts
scripts.release:check: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:release

author: Viora Tech Internship Team
